# SADCAT

To install (using R):

install.packages(“devtools”)

library(devtools)

install_github(“gandalfnicolas/SADCAT”)

library(SADCAT)

See articles/vignettes

# Package index

## All functions

- [`aggregate_responses()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/aggregate_responses.md)
  : Aggregate Responses
- [`All.steps_Dictionaries`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/All.steps_Dictionaries.md)
  : Unprocessed Full dictionary codings
- [`All.steps_Dictionaries_FT`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/All.steps_Dictionaries_FT.md)
  : Unprocessed Full dictionary codings shortened with Fasttext
- [`cldtable()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/cldtable.md)
  : Compact Letter Display Table
- [`clean_large_text()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/clean_large_text.md)
  : Clean Large Text
- [`clean_naresponses()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/clean_naresponses.md)
  : Clean na responses
- [`clean_symbols()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/clean_symbols.md)
  : Remove symbols
- [`Code_sent()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/Code_sent.md)
  : Code single-word responses into dictionaries and sentiment
- [`Code_single()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/Code_single.md)
  : Code single-word responses
- [`Code_words()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/Code_words.md)
  : Code single-word unprocessed responses
- [`Cohens_d_EMmeans()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/Cohens_d_EMmeans.md)
  : Cohen's d from Emmeans
- [`compute_embeddings()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/compute_embeddings.md)
  : Compute Sentence Embeddings
- [`compute_seed_similarities()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/compute_seed_similarities.md)
  : Compute Seed Similarities
- [`cosinize()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/cosinize.md)
  : Cosine Similarity Computation
- [`delete_ending_Ss()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/delete_ending_Ss.md)
  : Singular transform
- [`Dictionaries`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/Dictionaries.md)
  : Full dictionary codings
- [`Dictionaries_FT`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/Dictionaries_FT.md)
  : Full dictionary codings shortened with fasttext
- [`euclideanize()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/euclideanize.md)
  : Euclidean Distance Computation
- [`Full_Expand()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/Full_Expand.md)
  : Full Wordnet Expansion
- [`Full_preprocess()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/Full_preprocess.md)
  : Full preprocess
- [`Full_Vectors_Avg`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/Full_Vectors_Avg.md)
  : Average Word embeddings for expanded dictionaries
- [`get_Adj_Expansion()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/get_Adj_Expansion.md)
  : Wordnet adjective expansion
- [`get_Antonyms()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/get_Antonyms.md)
  : Wordnet antonym retriever
- [`get_derivrelto()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/get_derivrelto.md)
  : Wordnet derivationally related terms retriever
- [`get_Hypos()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/get_Hypos.md)
  : Wordnet hyponym retriever
- [`get_Member_holonym()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/get_Member_holonym.md)
  : Wordnet member holonym retriever

  : Wordnet part holonym retriever
- [`get_part_meronyms()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/get_part_meronyms.md)
  : Wordnet part meronyms retriever
- [`get_Syns()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/get_Syns.md)
  : Wordnet Synset retriever
- [`get_top_dictionary_matches()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/get_top_dictionary_matches.md)
  : Get Top SADCAT Dictionary Matches
- [`Jockers_norms`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/Jockers_norms.md)
  : Jockers/Rinker sentiment lexicon
- [`Lemmatize()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/Lemmatize.md)
  : Lemmatizer
- [`match_dictionaries()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/match_dictionaries.md)
  : Match Text Against SADCAT and/or SOCATS Dictionaries
- [`Obituary_data`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/Obituary_data.md)
  : Example obituary data for text coding
- [`prepare_sadcat_dictionaries()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/prepare_sadcat_dictionaries.md)
  : Prepare SADCAT Dictionaries for Quanteda Matching
- [`prepare_socats_dictionaries()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/prepare_socats_dictionaries.md)
  : Prepare SOCATS Dictionaries for Quanteda Matching
- [`preprocess_text()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/preprocess_text.md)
  : Preprocess Text Responses
- [`process_responses()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/process_responses.md)
  : Run the Full SADCAT Pipeline
- [`score_valence()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/score_valence.md)
  : Score Text Valence
- [`Seed_Vectors_allwords_Avg`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/Seed_Vectors_allwords_Avg.md)
  : Average word embeddings for seed dictionaries (all words)
- [`Seed_Vectors_Avg`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/Seed_Vectors_Avg.md)
  : Average Word embeddings for seed dictionaries
- [`Seed_Vectors_personcontext_Avg`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/Seed_Vectors_personcontext_Avg.md)
  : Average word embeddings for seed dictionaries (person context)
- [`Sentiments`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/Sentiments.md)
  : Sentiment lexicon data
- [`singularize2()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/singularize2.md)
  : Singularize a Word
- [`SOCATS_Dictionaries`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/SOCATS_Dictionaries.md)
  : Raw SOCATS social category dictionary
- [`Spanishdicts`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/Spanishdicts.md)
  : Full spanish dictionaries
- [`Spellcheck()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/Spellcheck.md)
  : Spellchecker
- [`Spellcheck2()`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/Spellcheck2.md)
  : Spell-check Text with SADCAT Dictionary
- [`Warriner_norms`](https://gandalfnicolas.github.io/SADCAT/reference/Warriner_norms.md)
  : Warriner et al. (2013) affective valence norms
